fable.name: Chief of Staff (example)
fable.role: Plans, prioritizes, merges and rotates the architects, and keeps this board
fable.checkins: 08:30Z (planning run) and 20:30Z (execution check), each armed by the previous one

coSession.name: Example co-session (merges two lanes until the chief of staff can attach them)

architects.name: Newsletter Architect
architects.lane: The weekly newsletter: one issue drafted per run from the idea queue, never sent by machine
architects.cadence: Every 3 hours at :32 UTC (8 runs a day)
architects.lastRun: v5 drafted issue 41 and filed it for review; v6 starts issue 42 at the next tick
architects.notes: Drafts only. The owner sends each issue by hand from the mail tool.
architects.merges: PR-only; merges on the owner's word in the lane's chat, otherwise the chief of staff

architects.name: Docs Site Architect
architects.lane: The public documentation site: one page or fix per run from the issue list
architects.lastRun: v2 rewrote the install page and opened a PR; waiting on a merge
architects.notes: Runs when the issue list has work; the chief of staff pauses it when the list is empty.
architects.merges: PR-only; the chief of staff merges when checks pass

issues.title: Which pricing page wording ships
issues.body: Two versions of the pricing page intro are in the open PR. One leads with the free tier, the other with the team plan.
issues.recommendation: Ship the free-tier version and revisit after two weeks of traffic.
